description: Use when the user states a thesis or a claim about the AI economy and wants the strongest case against it. Returns the side the claim sits on (or the question, when no side label fits), the strongest case against that side from a voice outside it, dated and linked, more opposing voices, and the dated tests that settle it; below the relevance floor, that DeepStack has no formed side on the claim.

claim.description: The thesis as the user states it, for example “AI demand is real”.

limit.description: How many further opposing voices to return after the strongest case.

name: deepstack_counter
title: The case against a thesis
